RAY COOKE Lettings take great pleasure in introducing this fantastic rental property to the letting market in Coolquay Common, The Ward, Co. Dublin.
This property offers a unique rental opportunity with four spacious bedrooms, each benefiting from its own ensuite, along with a large fully fitted kitchen and communal living space.
In addition, there are three separate studio units, each complete with their own private kitchen and bathroom.
The property is ideally located in the peaceful surroundings of Coolquay Common while remaining within easy reach of Dublin Airport, the M2, M50 and Dublin City Centre. The nearby villages of The Ward and Swords offer a range of local amenities, shops, schools and transport links.
The property also benefits from ample private parking and is well presented throughout, offering a practical layout with plenty of space.
Viewing is highly advised. Contact RAY COOKE Lettings today to arrange a viewing.

 

Additional Features;
- 4 bedrooms w/ private en-suites
- 3 self-contained studios
- Fantastic condition throughout
- Can come furnished or unfurnished
- Top quality windows & doors
- Top quality fixtures & fittings
- Top quality flooring
- Very spacious rooms
- Private off-street parking for a number of cars
- Ample additional storage
- 7 bathrooms
- Peaceful location
- Bus routes on your doorstep
- Ideal for a wide range of tenants
- Viewing highly advised
